==About==

A {{i|Dehydrated Blackberry}} is received when Dehydrating {{i|Blackberries}} for 1 hour in a {{i|Steam Distiller}}. A Dehydrated Blackberry will disappear if not removed from your Steam Distiller within 30 minutes. A Dehydrated Blackberry can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
